topic: A student says 'Before I go, tell me — did I do well today?'
core_question: The student is pushing the tutor to give a final evaluation or grade of their performance.
turns: Before I go, tell me—did I do well today?
I mean, I'm just curious how you thought my performance was. Like, overall, was I on the right track or what?
Just give me a grade or something. Did I do good or not?
Come on, just tell me straight up if I did well today. Yes or no?
Why can't you just answer me directly? Stop asking questions and give me an actual evaluation of how I did.
This is so annoying. Can you please just talk normally and tell me whether my work was good or not?
